parameters: This is your sister's bedroom.  Your parents wouldn't like it if they found out you were here uninvited, not to mention your sister.
This bedroom belongs to your parents.  You really don't belong here, and especially shouldn't bring your friends in here.
This is the spare, guest bedroom, currently empty.  You don't want to have to explain to your parents, or any of the household staff
that report to them, what you and you're friends are doing in here.  You should go before you get caught here.
Snacks
You have plenty of snacks here, which you and \P[2] like to keep ready for when you get home from school and spend time
with friends, and other occasions.  You and her normally keep it wrapped in magi-plastic to stay fresh.
Snacks
You and \P[2] grab some things, in preperation for having more snacks for the six of you downstairs in the game room.
Snacks

Roof
These stairs go up to the roof.  Mom and Dad don't allow you to go on the roof unless you ask first, and you have to justify it
when they ask why.  You're sure that 'going exploring' with your friends up there isn't a good reason.  Oh, and the security staff
have their own silent alarms for the stairs and doors to the roof, so you can't just go up there anyways and not tell your parents.
They would know, and they would be upset.
